describe: A rendering technique behind its feature (PLAN.md WP 11.1, ADR-0025 amendment 30): its feature entry and the advice code the registry raises while it is off, with a unit test that reads both through the registry; engine/gfx/features.ts registers it and hands the technique out only while it is on.
id: the module's path, engine/gfx/enhanced/<name> (its feature is feature:<name>, its advice GFX_NO_<NAME>): engine/gfx/enhanced/softShadows
next: replace the placeholder text; add {{NAME}}_FEATURE to TECHNIQUES in engine/gfx/features.ts, with a gate that hands the technique out only while it is on; measure its cost (node x perf <lab> --feature feature:{{name}}); then node x docs --write
games: a game defines no feature: it reads which are on (__engine.info().features) and turns one off with the view setting gfx.featuresOff
